title: Economic Health, Childcare, & New Hospital District
summary:
*   **Childcare and Family Support**: A report was presented on the current state and future goals of childcare, early education, and family support services in Austin.
*   **Economic Vitality & Growth**: Discussions focused on Austin's economic context, strategies for growth management, and recommendations for a comprehensive economic action plan.
*   **Healthcare District Initiative**: A presentation outlined the community's efforts and progress towards establishing a new hospital and healthcare district.
transcript:
MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL WORKSESSION 
NOVEMBER 20,2002
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORKSESSION
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20,2002
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they
occurred during the meeting.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, November 20,
2002 at One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, 3RD Floor Training Room, Austin, Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:00 a.m.
Briefings
1. Report by the Austin Child Care Council on its goals, work and accomplishments
regarding childcare, early education, and family support services.
The presentation was made by Rhonda Paver, Chair of the Austin Child Care
Council, and Dr. Joan Burnham, Chair of the Policy Development and Research
Committee, of the Austin Child Care Council.
2. Mayor's Task Force on the Economy: Presentation on Relationship of 
Growth
Management and Economic Vitality (Bill Hudnut, Senior Fellow, Urban Land Institute).
The presentation was made by Council Members Wynn and Dunkerley, and Bill
Hudnut, Urban Land Institute.
4. Presentation by members of the Hospital District Steering Committee regarding
community effort to form a hospital/health care district.
The presentation was made by Clarke Heidrick, Chair, and Committee Members
Rafael Quintanilla, David Hilgers, Judge Guy Herman, and Lowell Lebermann,
Vice Chair. Other Committee Members present were: Lew Little, Ed Adams, and
Gary Valdez. Mike McDonald, Assistant City Manager, was also present.
MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL WORK SESSION 2 
NOVEMBER 20,2002
3. Mayor's Task Force on the Economy: Briefing to outline Austin's economic context,
relative strengths, the role of the City in leveraging Austin's strengths, and recommending
a comprehensive economic action plan.
The presentation was made by Council Members Wynn and Dunkerley and John
Hockenyos, Texas Perspectives Inc.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 11:55 a.m. was approved on Council Member
Alvarez* motion, Council Member Slusher's second on a 5-0 vote. 
Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman was absent and Council Member Thomas was off the dais.
The minutes for November 20, 2002 were approved on December 5, 2002 on Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman's motion, Council Member Dunkcrley's second on a 7-0 vote.
